# Audette IT

> Personal IT help for family and friends, run by one person: everyday troubleshooting (wifi, slow computers, printers, accounts, parental controls) plus real infrastructure work (network design, Active Directory, self-hosted services, security hardening). Not a registered business. Contact: michael.audette@audetteit.com

Every page on this site has a Markdown version. Append `.md` to the page path, or request the normal URL with an `Accept: text/markdown` header.

## Pages

- [Home](https://audetteit.com/index.md): What Audette IT is, the two service tiers, and the four-stage process
- [Services](https://audetteit.com/services.md): Full list of everyday and infrastructure services
- [Contact](https://audetteit.com/contact.md): Email address and how the contact form works
- [Privacy](https://audetteit.com/privacy.md): What the site collects: contact form, opt-in Google Analytics, hosting
